title: Completed Workshop: Reusable Gift Wrap and Paper Box Making
description: This project funded a hands-on weekend workshop where participants learned how to turn clean cardboard mailers, paper bags, and leftover ribbon into gift boxes and reusable wrapping materials. The raised points covered cutting mats, paper punches, corner protectors, and printable folding guides, and the session has already been delivered successfully. We are keeping it in the example data because it is useful for testing completed-project states and showing how paper reuse projects can be framed as practical community events.
